content: {"like": [], "dislike": ["The story feels unrealistic and more like a fairy tale than reality.", "The premise is not believable, especially the coke snorting attorney and the intercontinental trip.", "The portrayal of a coke‑addicted daughter trying to rehab her alcoholic father on the fly is ridiculous.", "The storyline of an alcoholic father and drug‑addicted daughter on an intercontinental trip to reunite with a dying mother is absurd.", "The idea of reconciliation among the three under dire circumstances doesn't cut it."]}
